metadata.title: Operational Resilience

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for sustaining and recovering institutional operations through significant disruption.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Resilience, recovery, disaster recovery, and continuity technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting institutional operational resilience and continuity capability.

metadata.remarks: Operational Resilience is a composite pattern asserting that the institution can withstand, recover from, and continue operating through disruptive events. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be claimed only when all constituent resilience and continuity patterns are realized.

components.title: Backup and Recovery
components.description: Backup creation, protection, and recovery of data and systems following loss or corruption.

components.title: Ransomware Resilience
components.description: Ability to recover from ransomware and destructive malware without attacker cooperation.

components.title: Disaster Recovery
components.description: Recovery of systems and services following large-scale outages or catastrophic disruptions.

components.title: Continuity of Operations
components.description: Sustaining essential institutional functions during prolonged or systemic disruption.
